title: OL-20261121-2: ultrastable.io delegation and quniverse residue
body:
**Owner:** platform-manager
**Trigger:** cost-guard daily run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation singleaccount --live
**Status:** open

ultrastable.io's registrar nameservers are grace/leonidas but the .io registry still serves the quniverse pair; the quniverse io zone holds a stateless forwarder (ultrastable-site with UPSTREAM_ORIGIN), ultrastable-mail-in and ultrastable-mail-relay. When the zone activates in the ultrastable account, site/zonecutover.js attaches io domains, routes and mail rules; then the quniverse io zone and its three workers are deleted and ultrastable-dashboard drops MAIL_RELAY_URL. Three empty moved zone shells (app, net, org) in quniverse cannot be deleted while registrar metadata lingers (error 1315).
